property.statement: For the exercised nonzero run-cap path, unknown cost remains unknown and does not authorize starting another queued model variant. The run is reported with unknown budget status, not as proven exhausted.
property.predicate_basis_detail: The focused passing case's complete output/JUnit and the R1 removal falsifier are retained and hash-bound in the companion cost-checks artifact. The evidence is a simulated A consumer test, not external billing evidence.
property.property_divergence: The tested predicate is whether the consumer starts a sibling variant after an unknown-cost result. The mechanism is the existing run-budget guard's treatment of unknown amount/status, not an assertion that the run has spent a measured amount. R1 replaces that treatment with zero at a nonzero cap; the second variant completes and the unchanged guard assertion fails.
negative_controls: An explicit no-provider-call zero is separately represented on the skipped variant and is not conflated with the first variant's unknown cost.
The R1 target is an expected xfail under the mutation; the probe itself passes only when it observes that the target assertion goes red.

attempt_accounting: The three attempts are separate and non-additive. The 53-case wave was not rerun; the later PASS is one focused case. Older overlapping 50-case attempts are excluded.
limitations_and_next_owner: This is an A-side simulated unknown-cost consumer witness. It does not establish provider-reported usage as actual billing, independently reconciled spend, or a real monetary debit.

The test uses an explicit nondefault callback under a store-issued job admission; production dispatch normally runs the NL branch inline. The run_experiment result payload is captured by a test callback rather than persisted as a cost-bearing result artifact.

No B-owned producer settlement event, durable ledger, BudgetMiddleware/FileBudgetLedger receipt, exactly-once debit, lost-ack recovery, cancellation survival, cache-hit reuse, sibling-run isolation, or D-owned ledger is exercised.
The run budget status remains unknown; the case does not show a measured cost or prove that a monetary cap was exhausted.
B11 is not evaluated or changed by this packet. Its current row remains partial/not_adjudicated pending its own criterion and owner inputs.
The test-time receipts captured five modified tracked paths and three untracked A handoff paths. The immutable candidate SHA/tree is pinned, but this packet makes no clean-working-tree claim.
